notes: 🏪 GlowFounder, a new Glow app: test a business idea on a panel of simulated buyers before you launch
Buyers walk up to your stall in a 3D market square, read your pitch and decide. You see who buys, who passes and why
Pricing, unit economics, competitors and an A/B offer test are in the same studio. It runs in your browser and keeps your projects there
One tap hands the result to GlowChat to rewrite the pitch, or to GlowLead to plan a real launch test
